intents.title: Parentless snapshot refs
intents.statement: Each snapshot is a parentless commit under refs/afwe/snapshots/<project_id>/<snap_id>, so pruning is one update-ref delete plus prune and lineage lives in the ledger rather than in parent pointers.

intents.title: Private per-worktree snapshot index
intents.statement: Snapshots build through a private index under the common git dir derived from the worktree path, never the user's index, with core.safecrlf=false so mixed line endings cannot fail the snapshot.

intents.title: Exclude engine-owned, nested and oversized content
intents.statement: The snapshot tree excludes .afwe/index, state, turns, log and backups, removes nested repository gitlinks after add, and removes oversized files, reporting every exclusion instead of silently dropping it.

intents.title: Snapshot at turn begin and end
intents.statement: turn begin and turn ready/commit take a snapshot best effort, never block the turn on failure, and record the snapshot id, tree and phase in the ledger event.

intents.title: Snapshot listing and lookup
intents.statement: afwe snapshot list and snapshot show expose snapshot id, commit, tree, turn, phase, file count and exclusions through the API and MCP.

intents.title: Document snapshot refs and exclusions
intents.statement: README, TUTORIAL, SPEC and the skill describe parentless snapshot refs, the private index, the exclusion list, local-only transport and restore-forward coming next.
